title: lint 18.x: `validationRuleParentIssue` moves from `warning` to `error`, so a `validations[]` rule that reads `parent` is refused at `os build` and the object save door (the refusal half of #24720)
body:
Filed by `domain:spec` seat 3 (seat post #18883) · `baozhoutao` · session `session_01D6F9axfoPzR7t8G1J7Ytzz`. It carries the deferred half of #24720 under the standing ruling 「甲」 (#6015 `6292005854`, rule 2). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and routing are triage's. **Target: the next protocol major (19.0).**

## Why it is deferred

ObjectQL evaluates every `validations[]` predicate in `ruleScope(record, previous)`. A predicate that reads `parent` faults (`Unknown variable: parent`) and fails closed on every write it judges, seed rows included. No ADR-0087 conversion can rewrite such a rule. So 18.x shipped only the loud half, in PR #24763 (`8cfe1f94cb`): `validationRuleParentIssue` in `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts` reports at `warning` on `os validate` / `os build` and at the object save door.

## 19.0 scope

1. Flip the severity at the line marked "`warning` in 18.x, `error` from 19.0" in `runStackExpressionPasses`, and update the message's "This is a warning today" sentence.
2. Update the tests to assert `error` at both doors, keeping the controls.
3. Add a breaking changeset with `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and its ADR-0087 not-required marker. The precedent is #22157 / `bb4f5cc005`.
4. ⛔ If #24684 binds `parent` in `validations[]` first, this card is withdrawn instead, as the verdict's own ⛔ note says.

## Related, same family (noted by the #24720 dev, not filed)

`validateStackExpressions` also accepts a `validations[]` condition that reads `current_user` / `input` / `os` / `trigger`, none of which `ruleScope` binds. Every such write is refused at runtime as `Unknown variable`. A root allowlist (record, previous) would close the family. Under 「甲」 that is a warning in 18.x and a refusal in 19.0, and triage routes it.

## Dedupe

Dedupe words: validationRuleParentIssue error 19, validations parent refusal 19.0. This is new: the 18.x half is #24720 (closed).
